newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's three main crude ports still shut - ports.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's three main crude ports still shut - ports.

text.p: Mexico's three main crude shipping ports remained closed Thursday as of 0930 local/1530 GMT as a cold front brought dangerously high waves and winds to the Gulf of Mexico, port officials said.
Pajaritos, Dos Bocas and Cayo Arcas were shut for the second day, preventing any crude exporting ships from sailing.
On Wednesday, Pajaritos was closed at 0730 local/1330 GMT and Dos Bocas shut at 0820 local/1620 GMT, with Cayo Arcas closed at 1745 local/2345 GMT, port officials said.

At Pajaritos winds were reported at between 60 and 70 km per hour Thursday, and at Dos Bocas officials said wind speeds were dying down to 50 and 60 km per hour. Winds at Cayo Arcas were clocked at between 85 and 95 km per hour, port officials said.
